$destination175 = 91;

purpose: A precision-warning handler throws the original Exception after GLOBAL41 mutation. Reception preserves that exact Exception without replacement TypeError or Previous, skips the callee body and leaves the destination91 unchanged.

<?php

    echo 'warning|';
    $source175 = 41;
    return true;

function weakReceive175(int $value175) {
    echo 'weak-body:', $value175, ':', $GLOBALS['source175'], '|';
}
eval('declare(strict_types=1); function strictReceive175(int $value175) { echo "strict-body:", $value175, ":", $GLOBALS["source175"], "|"; } function strictCaller175() { global $source175; weakReceive175($source175); }');
set_error_handler('warning175');
$source175 = 1.5;
strictReceive175($source175);
echo 'weak-caller:', $source175, '|';
$source175 = 1.5;
try { strictCaller175(); }
catch (TypeError $caught175) { echo 'strict-caller:', $source175, '|'; }
purpose: Separate eval-compiled strict callee and strict caller units distinguish caller strictness: a weak caller converts1.5 for a strict callee; a strict caller rejects a weak callee argument before handler or body entry.
